verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents a public programmatic interface: an MCP endpoint at /api/app/public/v1/mcp over streamable HTTP, authenticated with per-integration API keys. A CLI with stable `--json` output also covers projects, loops, intentions, stories and tasks for agents and cron. The evidence does not show a conventional API reference, so how far the product can be driven through the public API is unproven. missing for 10: a documented REST/HTTP API reference (endpoints, operations, schemas), evidence of which product actions the public API exposes beyond agent task flows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Foreloop speaks MCP at /api/app/public/v1/mcp over streamable HTTP. An MCP client needs that URL and an API key and nothing else.
Create keys in Settings, under Connections, then API keys. Give every integration its own key, so revoking one does not take down the others.
Projects, loops, intentions, stories and tasks from a terminal — and from anything that can run one, including coding agents and cron.
`--json` works on any command and has a stable shape. Additive changes only.
